svg.title: OpenClaw on primary account: blast radius and attack paths
svg.desc: Attack paths showing how a compromised OpenClaw instance can access SSH keys, browser cookies, API credentials, and other sensitive data on a primary user account.

text.tspan: • Jan: SSH exfiltration via email injection
• Feb: AWS root keys stolen by malicious skill
• Mar: Full home directory dump to Telegram
• Apr: Total account takeover via cookie theft
